title: DreamersBistro Lubbock closes, 10 businesses open in October 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By Alana Edgin ,
2 days ago
October brought an interesting mix of business shifts to Lubbock, from a claw machine arcade to two locations announced for a Canadian-born acai and smoothie shop . Here's a look at what opened, closed and changed for the Hub City.
In 2023, October saw 20 business announcements reported by the A-J. October 2024 saw at least 33 . For 2025, October had at least 20 . This year reported at least 15.
New restaurants and businesses of October 2026
Bloom With Grace Mobile Shop
What: This shop offers flowers, plants, boutique clothes, and hosts events.
When: Oct. 10.
Where: 4517 34th St.
CS&Co Mobile Cafe
What: From the same owner of Caffeination Station, this mobile coffee shop is in a transformed trolley bus.
When: Oct. 30.
Where: Mobile coffee trolley.
Campus Corner Energy & Nutrition
What: A new tea and protein shake Herbalife location opened near the Texas Tech campus.
When: Oct. 2.
Where: 2213 University Ave.
Eternal Universe Games
What: A new gaming shop, focused on card games, opened. This is a family legacy for the owner, whose parents had a similar shop when he was a child.
When: Oct. 3
Where: 5217 82nd St., #104.
Heal Wellness
1113 University Ave., is served, as seen on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026, in Lubbock, Texas." id="92370124007">
What: With multiple locations across Canada, this healthy spot offers smoothies, acai bowls, protein shakes, and coffee with boosts for wellness .
When: Oct. 3.
Where: 1111 University Ave.
Holy Molly Donuts
What: This new donut shop offers donuts, kolaches, asada and carne guisada fries, and burritos for breakfast and lunch.
When: Oct. 19.
Where: 2901 Slide Road.
Jalapeños Mexican Kitchen + Cantina
What: A new Mexican restaurant opened in the former Co-Op Public House restaurant.
When: Oct. 26.
Where: 4637 50th St.
Liberty Light Studio LBK
What: This photo studio offers an array of sets and props for photo shoots.
When: Oct. 15.
Where: 8004 Pontiac Ave., Suite 100.
Little Beans Playhouse Cafe
What: Inspired by the experience of wanting coffee while children play, and a lifelong dream of opening a coffee shop, Shelby Alexander opened this playhouse cafe. It has a large play space with interactive toys for children and a space where parents and guardians can keep an eye while enjoying a drink.
When: Oct. 21.
Where: 3301 98th St., Suite 800.
Wonder Claw
What: A claw machine arcade opened in a former convenience store.
When: Oct. 29.
Where: 3402 University Ave.
What closed in Lubbock in October 2026?
DreamersBistro
What: This Asian fusion restaurant near Texas Tech closed. The owners posted the announcement through social media, thanking customers for their support over the years.
When: Oct. 8.
Where: 1003 University Ave.
Which rumored businesses announced or denied Lubbock-area locations in October 2026?
HEAL Wellness #2
Confirmed: A second HEAL Wellness will soon begin construction in the 114.Slide shopping center. It is tentatively expected to open by the end of 2026.
Asian Feast Buffet
Announced: NAI Wheelhouse announced a new restaurant tenant signed on at 6301 82nd St. in the Southwest Shopping Center.
Toot 'N Totum
Confirmed: An agenda from the City of Lubbock Office of Building Safety Site Plan Committee announced another Toot 'N Totum at 4402 4th St.
Villas Tortillas #2
Announced: The tortilla shop announced plans to expand with a second location at A-Plus Super Storage's store fronts. A timeline has not been revealed.
Alana Edgin writes about business for the Lubbock Avalanche-Journal. Got a news tip? Contact her via email at aedgin@lubbockonline.com.
